references.text: Jesus heals all kinds of diseases and afflictions, demonstrating his power over sickness and his compassion, similar to what is shown in Matthew 8:3.
God heals all your diseases, reflecting Jesus' healing act in Matthew 8:3.
The prophecy about the Messiah bearing our sicknesses and wounds foretells Jesus' healing ministry as demonstrated in Matthew 8:3.
Another event where Jesus heals by touch, showing his willingness and power to cleanse and heal.
Similar to the event in Matthew 8:3, where Jesus heals a leper by touch and word, demonstrating his authority over purity and disease.
